verdict.rationale: OpenCode's marketing advertises multi-session, meaning you can "start multiple agents in parallel on the same project." Desktop tabs support running several sessions side by side, so parallel task attempts are possible. However, nothing shows a built-in way to compare attempts or pick a winner, and running parallel agents in the same project suggests no isolation between attempts. missing for 10: isolated per-attempt workspaces (e.g. worktrees/branches), side-by-side diff/result comparison, a select-and-apply-winner workflow, in-depth docs beyond a marketing tagline, independent hands-on corroboration of parallel attempts.
